sentence: Leaders come in all shapes and sizes, but successful leaders tend to have one thing in common: the ability to share someone else's feelings, known as empathy. While empathy forms in everyone to some degree, effective leaders know how to develop this emotional guidance system to connect with others' feelings and perspectives. However, empathy in leaders is more than simply being kind to employees, clients, and customers. Empathetic people seem more approachable, focusing on the words of others. Listening to the needs of employees enables leaders to clearly identify what makes them feel heard. Utilized in this way, empathy can be considered a crucial part of maintaining employee satisfaction. Leaders who are unable to surround themselves with competent employees will not be successful. Indeed, a leader's failure to empathize with talented workers is one of the main situations that could lead them to leave an organization.

chunks.text: Leaders come in all shapes and sizes, but successful leaders tend to have one thing in common: the ability to share someone else's feelings, known as empathy.

the ability to share someone else's feelings

chunks.text: While empathy forms in everyone to some degree, effective leaders know how to develop this emotional guidance system to connect with others' feelings and perspectives.

errors.ask: empathy forms in everyone에서 forms는 무엇일까요?

chunks.text: However, empathy in leaders is more than simply being kind to employees, clients, and customers. Empathetic people seem more approachable, focusing on the words of others.
chunks.ko: 그러나 지도자의 공감은 그저 직원과 의뢰인과 손님에게 친절한 것 이상이다. 공감하는 사람은 남의 말에 귀를 기울이기에 더 다가가기 쉬워 보인다
chunks.praise: more than simply ~ 를 '그저 ~ 이상'으로 본 거 정말 잘했어요.

errors.ask: more than simply ~ 는 무엇을 말할까요?
focusing on ~ 은 앞 내용에 어떻게 붙나요?

chunks.ko: 직원들이 무엇을 필요로 하는지 듣는 일은, 무엇이 그들에게 자기 말이 받아들여진다고 느끼게 하는지를 지도자가 또렷이 알아보게 해 준다
chunks.praise: Listening을 주어로 잡은 거 정말 잘했어요.

points.en: listening to the needs of employees

points.answer: 무엇이 그들에게 자기 말이 들린다고 느끼게 하는지

chunks.text: Utilized in this way, empathy can be considered a crucial part of maintaining employee satisfaction.
chunks.ko: 이렇게 쓰일 때 공감은 직원 만족을 지켜 가는 데 아주 중요한 부분으로 여겨질 수 있다
chunks.praise: 맨 앞 분사구를 뒤의 empathy와 이어 붙인 거 정말 잘했어요.

chunks.text: Indeed, a leader's failure to empathize with talented workers is one of the main situations that could lead them to leave an organization.
